name: Narumon Suksai
bio:
Narumon's strategic mind was honed not on the racetrack, but in the complex world of supply chain management. After earning her MBA, she spent years optimizing logistics for a large automotive manufacturer, developing a keen eye for predicting trends and mitigating risks. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, she transitioned her skills to racing, starting as a data analyst before quickly rising to the role of strategist.

Narumon's approach is data-driven, yet she never underestimates the human element. She believes in fostering open communication within the team, ensuring that every member understands the overall strategy and their role in achieving it. Her unique background allows her to see patterns and opportunities that others might miss, making her a valuable asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport. Her focus is always long term, focusing on extracting maximum value over a whole race, rather than short term gain.

physical.hairStyle: long, straight, often pulled back in a neat bun
physical.description: Narumon has a focused and intelligent look, with a warm smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a lucky rabbit's foot
Meticulously color-codes all her data charts
Has a habit of humming quietly when deep in thought
